articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr.’s advisory contract over 1789 Capital’s Polymarket investment
articles.snippet: Trump Jr. joined Kalshi as a strategic adviser in January 2025, helping the prediction market expand its customer base and strengthen its market presence.

articles.title: China’s $3.2 Billion AI Pipeline Still Calls for Nvidia Chips Washington Restricts
articles.snippet: Chinese data center projects are still being designed around restricted Nvidia processors, even as Beijing pushes domestic alternatives.

articles.title: Who Is Colette Kress, Jensen Huang’s Successor as Nvidia CEO?
articles.snippet: Nvidia’s longtime finance chief inherits its first leadership transition in 33 years, bringing decades of technology experience and Wall Street credibility to a company facing a very public leadership test.
